subject: Evaluation handover: acceptance scenarios, owners, and timeline
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@medsys.com>; Anika Rao <anika.rao@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation handover: acceptance scenarios, owners, and timeline

Hi Jared / Anika —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, attached is a concise mutual action plan (RDW_MAP_v3.pdf) and the evaluation test matrix (eval-test-matrix.xlsx) that translate your business goals into pass/fail acceptance tests. Key asks for this note: please review the owner assignments and the timeline below, and flag anything you cannot commit to by EOD Friday so we can adjust the plan.

High-level acceptance signals (short):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation below 450ms for 512-token prompts (test suite A).
- Quality: F1 >= 0.78 on your labeled clinical extraction set (QC test B).
- Safety: Zero PII leakage incidents on seeded tests and zero critical infra exceptions in 72h soak.
- Integration: End-to-end demo with live staging dataset and logs streaming to your SIEM.

Owners & exit gates (summary row from the attached MAP):
- Redwood: runtime config, model variant, streaming + KV cache setup (Owner: David).
- MedSys Eng: staging dataset delivery and schema mapping (Owner: Jared).
- MedSys Security: SOC2 evidence and KMS confirmation (Owner: Samir).
- Customer success / renewal: agreed acceptance window and rollout plan (Owner: Anika).

Recommended timeline (anchored to kickoff next Monday):
- Week 1: dataset delivery + access, initial smoke tests (pass = dataset schema validated).
- Week 2: run test matrix A/B, tune batching/quantization suggestions (pass = latency & QC thresholds met).
- Week 3: soak + security review + canary demo (pass = 72h soak w/o critical exceptions).

Attachments: RDW_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP summary + owner RACI), eval-test-matrix.xlsx (detailed test cases), nda-scan.pdf (for your legal).

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min alignment meeting — proposed slots in the shared Drive link.

Thanks,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@medsys.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Rao <anika.rao@medsys.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsys.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation handover: acceptance scenarios, owners, and timeline

David —

Appreciate the clear doc. A couple quick clarifying questions before we mark owners:
1) The latency target you list is for 512-token prompts — can you also include a 128-token target? Our most common flow is short prompts.
2) For the QA metric (F1 >= 0.78), can you share the baseline results from your initial run so we can see delta?
3) Security: Samir flagged the KMS pattern — we need confirmation that key material never leaves our VPC in the Private deployment option. Is that covered in the MAP?

If you can answer the 3 items and update the MAP, we can confirm owners and get procurement moving.

On timelines: Week 2 is tight for us because of a vendor freeze; can Week 2 and Week 3 be combined into a single two-week validation window instead?

Thanks,
Jared
Director of Engineering, MedSys Health
Jared.Lowe@medsys.com | (415) 777-2000

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@medsys.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@medsys.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation handover: acceptance scenarios, owners, and timeline

Hi Jared / Anika —

Short answers and concrete updates we will make:
1) Latency: We will add a 128-token target of p95 < 220ms in the MAP. The 512-token number remains p95 < 450ms. Those reflect our tuned model variant for your dataset profile.
2) Baselines: Attached to this reply (see drive link and the 1st sheet in eval-test-matrix.xlsx) are the baseline runs we executed against a synthetic subset that mirrors your schema — you should see the F1 baseline at 0.72. The plan is to reach 0.78 with two targeted prompt templates and a small prompt engineering pass.
3) KMS/VPC: For Private deployment, customer-managed KMS is available and key material remains within your KMS/HSM. We will add an explicit line in the MAP and point to the Private deployment appendix. Samir — can you confirm if you need an architecture diagram or an operator checklist?

Regarding the timeline: combining Week 2 & Week 3 into a two-week validation window is reasonable. Updated timeline we propose in RDW_MAP_v3 (v3.1):
- Week 1 (kickoff): dataset + schema + access tokens.
- Weeks 2–3 (validation): run the test matrix, latency tuning, and 72h soak.
- Week 4: legal/procurement close + go/no-go decision.

Owner handoff matrix (from v3.1):
- Delivery: Jared / MedSys Eng.
- Integration & runtime: David / Redwood Eng.
- Security sign-off: Samir / MedSys Sec.
- Acceptance sign-off: Anika / MedSys Product.

We'll update the MAP and uplink the v3.1 PDF by EOD. If that works, David and I will lock the alignment call for Tue 23rd.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@medsys.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation handover: acceptance scenarios, owners, and timeline

Thanks Marissa — and Jared, Samir —

I've uploaded RDW_MAP_v3.1.pdf to the Drive link and refreshed the test matrix (eval-test-matrix.xlsx) with the 128-token latency row and the baseline results. Key changes are summarized at the top of RDW_MAP_v3.1. Two concrete asks from us to keep the schedule:
1) Dataset delivery (masked/staging) by end of Week 1 (we can accept a s3 path or GCS share).
2) Security contact availability for an architecture call on Wed (Samir?).

If those two greenlights happen, we will proceed with the combined 2-week validation as Marissa outlined. I've also added a discrete acceptance test for logs: "logs include correlation_id + token-level latency" — pass requires log sampling during the 72h soak.

Proposed short meeting: Tue 23rd 11:00-11:30 PT or Wed 24th 09:00-09:30 PT. Please pick one and I will send an invite.

-David

From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@medsys.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@medsys.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation handover: acceptance scenarios, owners, and timeline

David / Marissa —

This looks good. Confirming the following from our side:
- We will deliver a masked staging dataset (S3) by EOD Monday.
- Samir will join Wed architecture call and confirm KMS constraints (Samir, can you confirm?).
- Procurement has visibility on the MAP and will prepare a 60-day evaluation contract once we hit Week 1 milestones (procurement@medsys.com).

We accept the updated pass/fail criteria and the two-week validation window. Please send the calendar invite for Tue 23rd 11:00 PT and include the Drive link and the HubSpot record in the invite.

Thanks,
Anika Rao
VP Product, MedSys Health
anika.rao@medsys.com | (415) 888-4433
